reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows a recalled model (BE10019US-PI), so the model is confirmed.
The purchase is from Amazon.com, which is the listed retailer, and the date falls inside the sale window, so no receipt is required.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial number, or payout account with this claim.
The destruction photo does not show the product marked with 'RECALLED' on the front and rear of the seatback, so it does not comply with the required destruction instructions.
Per the program's policy, a destruction photo that does not show the instructed destruction is asked for again rather than denied.

input.question_for_claimant: Your destruction photo does not show the unit marked as required. Please send a new photo of the seatback showing the word "RECALLED" written in large letters on both the front and the rear, using a marker. The refund amount ($191.11) will also receive a person's review after approval.
